text: Consensus in decentralized systems presents a two sided cost problem: creating consensus raises the costs of prepping, processing, and storing information, while reducing the number of computational checks increases the risk of collusion attacks that could change the record.
citation: Kaal, Digital Asset Market Evolution (2020). SSRN: https://papers.ssrn.com/sol3/papers.cfm?abstract_id=3606663
abstract: Creating consensus requires increase costs of prepping, processing, and storing information.333 On the other hand, fewer computational checks for consensus increase the risk of collusion attacks that could change the record.
